inherits: C036 same-language merge and separator extraction

exact_object: A deterministically discovered forest of pure affine modules and producer-lane single-head Horn modules with logarithmic per-module shared-variable interfaces

discovery.affine_modules: connected components of the affine factor-variable incidence subgraph
discovery.horn_producer_lanes: for each positive head, its producers are sorted by factor identifier and producer rank k is assigned to lane k; negative Horn constraints use lane zero
discovery.horn_modules: connected components inside each producer lane; every resulting Horn module is single-head by construction
discovery.interaction_graph: one module edge for every nonempty shared-variable set
admission: the module interaction graph is a forest
every shared variable belongs to at most two discovered modules
every module boundary has size at most floor(log2 L)
all modules are AFFINE_GF2 or producer-lane SINGLE_HEAD_HORN

constructive_theorem: For every admitted raw factor instance of encoding size L, producer-lane module discovery, a verified derived variable vtree, exact bottom-up composition, SAT witness recovery, UNSAT replay, and total certificate construction run in sum_M 2^{|B_M|} poly(L_M), hence polynomial under |B_M| <= floor(log2 L).
decisive_localization: Producer-lane isolation removes duplicate-head collision as an immediate refusal. On the C039.1 blow-up family it constructs a module star, but the central module has n shared q_i variables, so the current exact cross-language table correctly returns OPEN_INTERFACE_WIDTH.
not_a_new_parameter: The discovered maximum module boundary is an explicit bounded-interface condition on an acyclic module join graph, not a renamed universal width measure.

claim_boundary: C040 discovers and compiles an acyclic logarithmic-interface portfolio class only. Producer lanes can isolate duplicate Horn heads, but large or hypergraph interfaces still return OPEN. The load-bearing proof object is the module-forest dynamic program; the derived variable vtree is a verified embedding witness, not a universal width certificate.
